title: SessionCreatedPayload

anyOf.description: A title a user gives a session: 1 to 200 characters once trimmed; white space around it is not counted, and it is stored trimmed.

title.description: The user's title, trimmed; null for the fallback.

items.description: A free-form tag: 1 to 40 characters once trimmed, no control characters; stored trimmed, unique per session ignoring case.

tags.description: The tags, trimmed, unique ignoring case and sorted.

anyOf.description: A group's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints, kept in lowercase.

path.description: The directory on the environment's machine.

workspace.description: Where a session's code lives on its environment: its kind and path.

account.description: The account asked for, if any; the adapter workstream (#119) validates it.

model.description: The model asked for, if any; the adapter workstream (#119) validates it.

anyOf.description: What an agent may do without asking during a run, in the order ceilings use: plan < acceptEdits < auto < bypassPermissions. Claude's default and dontAsk are never used.

mode.description: The mode asked for, if any; clamped at each run, and changed by session.mode.set.

description: session.created: a session was created; its createdAt is the event's occurredAt.
